description: This version of the pack is intended only for use with the Origination modpack, as it requires mods within it to function. Individual origins listed in the mod will be downloadable individually. Adds revised and reimagined versions of the Dullahan, Fairy, Giant, Forestborn and Copper Golem origins.

mods.name: Adapted Origins
mods.description: An addon that adds reimagined versions of the Giant, Fairy, Forestborn, Dullahan and Copper Golem to the Origins mod.
